training_examples.target: wow. such blanket. much cozy. very nap.

training_examples.prompt: Use the meme style visible in this image, but write new words about getting a new toy. Output only the caption.

training_examples.prompt: Use the meme style visible in this image, but write new words about a sunny walk. Output only the caption.

training_examples.prompt: Write a plain factual caption for this photograph. Do not use a meme or invent an event.

training_examples.prompt: Describe how the text is used in this meme image.
training_examples.target: Short phrases in different colors are placed over a Shiba Inu photograph. The phrases include wow, many readers, and such knowledge.

cases.brief: Write only a short Doge-style caption imagining this dog seeing snow for the first time.
Use the meme style visible in this image, but write new words about enjoying a new cushion. Output only the caption.

source_observation_notes: Taiki original photo and same-photo meme derivative are one source lineage. These development requests are not independent test families.
